title: Sharks and whales
examples: How do whales breathe if they live in the water?
What is the biggest animal in the ocean?

explain.say: Some animals look very similar to each other. Sharks and whales can look quite alike in the water.
Fish usually breathe using gills to get oxygen from the water. Whales, however, breathe air like us.
Mammals are warm-blooded and they drink milk when they are babies. Sharks do not have these traits.
The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth. It is a mammal, not a fish.
Think about a dolphin. It lives in the ocean like a whale. It breathes air through a blowhole.
A common mistake is thinking all ocean animals breathe with gills. Remember that mammals, like whales, use lungs.

faq.a: Yes, sharks are classified as fish. They breathe using gills to extract oxygen from the water.

faq.q: Do whales ever come onto land?
faq.a: Whales are mostly in the water, but some species can come close to the surface or shore.
asks: Do whales live only in the sea?

faq.q: What makes a mammal different from a fish?
faq.a: Mammals are warm-blooded, they breathe air with lungs, and they feed their young milk.
asks: What do mammals have that fish do not?
How do we know if an animal is a mammal?

faq.q: How big is the blue whale?
faq.a: The blue whale is enormous. It is the largest animal known to have ever lived on Earth.
asks: Is the blue whale the biggest animal?

faq.a: No, sharks do not typically eat whales. They are different types of animals with different diets.

facts: Sharks belong to the group of fish.
Whales are mammals, meaning they breathe air.
The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth.
Mammals nurse their young with milk.

quiz.why: Sharks are fish, and fish use gills to breathe underwater.

wrong.1: Whales use lungs to breathe air, not gills.
wrong.2: Dolphins are mammals and breathe air through blowholes.
wrong.3: Turtles breathe air using lungs, like mammals.

quiz.say: What is a key trait of mammals?
quiz.why: Mammals are defined by traits like giving live birth and nursing their young.

wrong.1: Gills are for fish, not for mammals.
wrong.2: Mammals are warm-blooded, which helps them stay warm.
wrong.3: Some mammals, like humans, live on land.

quiz.say: If an animal breathes air through a blowhole, it is most likely a:
quiz.why: Blowholes are characteristic openings used by whales and dolphins to breathe air.

wrong.0: Octopuses use gills, similar to fish.
wrong.2: Sharks use gills to extract oxygen from the water.
wrong.3: Most fish breathe using gills throughout their bodies.
